transcript.text: Thank you all for the opportunity to speak. I want to be honest about what I believe the resolution should address. The core issue is that during our project meetings, I've frequently been interrupted or redirected before I can finish my points. This has made it difficult for me to contribute effectively to the project. What I'd like the resolution to address specifically is how our future meetings are facilitated and coordinated. I think we need a shared written channel for project coordination — so that decisions, action items, and discussion points aren't just happening verbally in meetings where some voices can get talked over — and I'd also like to see agendas sent out at least 24 hours in advance so that everyone comes prepared and there's a clear structure for how the meeting runs. I think these two changes would go a long way toward making sure the communication dynamics on this project work for everyone on the team.
